pull_request.title: Calorimeter: validate high-statistics staggered ECAL calibration
pull_request.head: codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration
pull_request.body:
This follows #136 and studies only its unchanged physical staggered ECAL prototype under DES-030/DES-031. Generated **100,000 training + 20,000 fresh validation electrons**, independently uniform in E=10–80 GeV, eta −3..3 and full phi, with **12 DDSim workers**. Froze both training-only calibrations in Git before independent validation; retained code, recipes, compact statistics/covariance and PNG/PDF/**SVG** figures.

The recorded default for later use is **`nodd-ecal-staggered-spline-v1`**; `nodd-ecal-staggered-linear-v1` is retained as the comparator. The [versioned manifest](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/frozen/manifest.json) records coefficient/geometry/feature hashes, units and applicability. The [reuse guide](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/reuse.md) supplies a truth-free NumPy API/CLI, with compatibility guards and no refitting. All four pre/post energy-ratio series reproduce the retained full 20k predictions bit-for-bit; ten-k chunks show only quantified last-bit matrix-product roundoff (maximum 4.89e-15). The coefficients, frozen numerical source and published statistics/plots are unchanged. A separate exact-revision SoftEng review passed all 16 NumPy controls and independently reproduced the full20k equality and chunked roundoff, with no material finding.

On the **same fresh 20k**, inclusive sample SD(R)/mean(R) is **38.313% raw, 31.338% historical 10k ensemble, 31.322% retuned linear and 30.209% spline**. The spline gains 1.112 percentage points against the new linear comparator. More training with the linear recipe makes little difference here; this comparison also changes tuning/refitting and ensemble construction, so it does not isolate training size. The old 32.22% cross-fit result used a different cohort.

![Independent angular comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/83eb6a8828eea3cfd54da07650ca226a88f7c2e9/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/results/angular-comparison.png)

The global spline mean closes to **1.00300**, but local biases remain: energy-slice means 0.96975–1.02622 and folded-phi means 0.61376–1.10597. Sector-edge widths remain 73–75%, versus 11–13% in interior bins. All 84 zeros remain; spline gain clipping is 8.790%, feature extrapolation 1.095%, half-energy tail 9.380%. Global rescaling leaves SD/mean unchanged and raises spline RMS from 28.929% to 30.301%; closed linear RMS is 31.412%. These are spectrum-averaged non-Gaussian widths, not intrinsic fixed-energy resolution or detector acceptance.

The prospective chain uses 70k fit/15k tuning/15k closure, a common ridge search for both new recipes, response refit on 85k and a separate global closure factor. The spline adds predeclared bases/interactions to measured hit features; truth energy/direction are absent from inference. The original-method 1/2/4/8k learning curve is weak/nonmonotonic and explicitly exploratory, including a shifted bootstrap contrast range.

Validation: all 120,000 primaries/76,941,173 hits/all 12 workers audited; 22 original controls plus 7 reuse controls; full old 10k native feature regression; complete frozen-model records independently reproduced bit-for-bit before unblinding; 1,000 shared validation bootstraps and 200 full training/selection/refit/closure bootstraps; correlated 120-width/60-contrast matrices verified; all 18 PNG/SVG exports byte-identical on standalone replot. Final exact-revision independent PhysVal assessment is retained in the session journal.

Transport used 118.6 minutes summed wall, 20.93 CPU-hours, at most 2.672 GiB child RSS and 152.506 GB ROOT. At least 232.7 GiB remained free; no trimming/deletion. ROOT, exact event inputs/ledgers, full audits and event-level features/predictions stay local and ignored. Closed calibration and reuse work is now accounted below; the active accounting turn remains excluded.

[Report](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/README.md) · [Vector SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/83eb6a8828eea3cfd54da07650ca226a88f7c2e9/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/results/angular-comparison.svg) · [Reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/reproduce.md)

Prepared for maintainer merge review. **Dependency order: #133 → #134 → #135 → #136 → #137**. This PR still targets #136; merge dependencies and retarget successors to main, preserving source commits referenced by the frozen evidence (use merge commits for this stack). Recheck CI after retargeting. This preparation does not approve or merge any predecessor. No geometry integration, human design sign-off or engineering acceptance.


Token accounting (2026-11-12): **108,043,890 observed input+output tokens across 15 closed turns and 431 requests**. The canonical work labels are **Staggered ECAL: 100k training and 20k independent validation** (84,245,571) and **Staggered ECAL model reuse and PR137 merge preparation** (23,798,319). Cached input 107,174,400 and reasoning output 224,181 are subsets, not additions. Explicit parent/child identities and fork boundaries are verified; earlier inherited usage, earlier PR work and the active accounting turn are excluded. These are client observations, not billing or complete-device estimates. [Accounting and attribution](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-11-12-pr137-accounting.md).


## Complete PR133–137 merge/accounting closeout

The complete closed-turn study record now covers **53 turns /1,311 requests /306,136,254 observed tokens** across12 canonical task owners. This includes benchmark generation and local display/review, all10k controls, staggering, high-statistics calibration/reuse and four closed software assignments. The earlier15 accounts/counters are preserved;38 additional turns were imported once. Shared PR references are not additive; cached input/reasoning are subsets. One unobserved interrupted input and the active coordinating turn remain unknown/excluded.

All five PRs are labelled `enhancement` and `campaign:calorimeters`. Main-push validation and Pages build retain all canonical observations and derive daily work labels automatically. The new chain guard checks all five records, recorded source ancestry and byte-identical frozen coefficients/core.17 synthetic Git controls plus76 accounting tests and both Node suites pass; separate integration/accounting assessment found no actionable issue at346bd704. Final closed review counters were then added without science changes.

GitHub automatically marked PR134 merged into the PR133 branch during a publishing race; no merge to main occurred. Its full10k study is retained in PR133 with ordinary corrective history. Remaining merge order: **133→135→136→137**, using merge commits and retargeting each dependent PR to main after its predecessor. PR135 now targets PR133 directly. No squash/rebase of the frozen source history.

See `docs/validation/ecal-chain/README.md` for exact coverage and post-merge reconciliation. Actual future merge SHAs/timestamps and a selected final feature milestone must be captured from GitHub after the human merges; they are not invented now. Scientific artifacts and calibration remain unchanged.

This follows #136 and studies only its unchanged physical staggered ECAL prototype under DES-030/DES-031. Generated **100,000 training + 20,000 fresh validation electrons**, independently uniform in E=10–80 GeV, eta −3..3 and full phi, with **12 DDSim workers**. Froze both training-only calibrations in Git before independent validation; retained code, recipes, compact statistics/covariance and PNG/PDF/**SVG** figures.

The recorded default for later use is **`nodd-ecal-staggered-spline-v1`**; `nodd-ecal-staggered-linear-v1` is retained as the comparator. The [versioned manifest](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/frozen/manifest.json) records coefficient/geometry/feature hashes, units and applicability. The [reuse guide](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-staggered-highstat-calibration/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/reuse.md) supplies a truth-free NumPy API/CLI, with compatibility guards and no refitting. All four pre/post energy-ratio series reproduce the retained full 20k predictions bit-for-bit; ten-k chunks show only quantified last-bit matrix-product roundoff (maximum 4.89e-15). The coefficients, frozen numerical source and published statistics/plots are unchanged. A separate exact-revision SoftEng review passed all 16 NumPy controls and independently reproduced the full20k equality and chunked roundoff, with no material finding.

On the **same fresh 20k**, inclusive sample SD(R)/mean(R) is **38.313% raw, 31.338% historical 10k ensemble, 31.322% retuned linear and 30.209% spline**. The spline gains 1.112 percentage points against the new linear comparator. More training with the linear recipe makes little difference here; this comparison also changes tuning/refitting and ensemble construction, so it does not isolate training size. The old 32.22% cross-fit result used a different cohort.

![Independent angular comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/83eb6a8828eea3cfd54da07650ca226a88f7c2e9/docs/validation/ecal-highstat/results/angular-comparison.png)

The global spline mean closes to **1.00300**, but local biases remain: energy-slice means 0.96975–1.02622 and folded-phi means 0.61376–1.10597. Sector-edge widths remain 73–75%, versus 11–13% in interior bins. All 84 zeros remain; spline gain clipping is 8.790%, feature extrapolation 1.095%, half-energy tail 9.380%. Global rescaling leaves SD/mean unchanged and raises spline RMS from 28.929% to 30.301%; closed linear RMS is 31.412%. These are spectrum-averaged non-Gaussian widths, not intrinsic fixed-energy resolution or detector acceptance.

The prospective chain uses 70k fit/15k tuning/15k closure, a common ridge search for both new recipes, response refit on 85k and a separate global closure factor. The spline adds predeclared bases/interactions to measured hit features; truth energy/direction are absent from inference. The original-method 1/2/4/8k learning curve is weak/nonmonotonic and explicitly exploratory, including a shifted bootstrap contrast range.

Validation: all 120,000 primaries/76,941,173 hits/all 12 workers audited; 22 original controls plus 7 reuse controls; full old 10k native feature regression; complete frozen-model records independently reproduced bit-for-bit before unblinding; 1,000 shared validation bootstraps and 200 full training/selection/refit/closure bootstraps; correlated 120-width/60-contrast matrices verified; all 18 PNG/SVG exports byte-identical on standalone replot. Final exact-revision independent PhysVal assessment is retained in the session journal.

Transport used 118.6 minutes summed wall, 20.93 CPU-hours, at most 2.672 GiB child RSS and 152.506 GB ROOT. At least 232.7 GiB remained free; no trimming/deletion. ROOT, exact event inputs/ledgers, full audits and event-level features/predictions stay local and ignored. A global scale correction can restore the mean while leaving SD/mean unchanged. Narrower widths require better event-dependent corrections; more statistics can help learn those, while the physical seam losses remain.

**ECAL-HIGHSTAT-PHYSVAL-PROTOCOL**, reviewed **e9aabc83d3c8aa4127d1bcd824db0a134e69e7b0**. The proposed protocol is scientifically reasonable with the following frozen boundaries.

- **Primary model:** use linear-response ridge with piecewise-linear spline features and a small, predeclared set of physical interactions. It targets mean \(S/E_\mathrm{true}\); log-response fitting requires separate retransformation treatment and special handling of zeros. Keep log-response/log-signal variants secondary. Deduplicate training-quantile knots and record the resulting basis, bounds and extrapolation/clipping rates.
- **Samples:** staggered geometry only; independently uniform energy, η and φ as specified. Keep primary streams and event identities disjoint. Split the new 100k into **70k fit / 15k tuning / 15k closure**. Select settings on tuning, refit the chosen response model on 85k, then determine closure using the untouched 15k.
- **Closure:** a single global \(C=1/\overline{E_\mathrm{pre}/E_\mathrm{true}}\), including zeros, is a suitable primary. Freeze it before fresh-validation inspection. It changes means and thresholds, while leaving CV exactly unchanged. Preserve pre/post-closure results and test energy-, angle- and region-dependent bias separately.
- **Learning curve:** the unchanged original model can use **1k/2k/5k/8k** training budgets within each existing outer fold, with three fixed nested subset orders. These curves are exploratory because the old10k already informed development. Bootstrap seeds jointly; they share the same validation events. At 8k, all three subset orders should produce identical results.
- **Final comparators:** staggered raw, original ten-feature architecture retrained on the declared new budget, improved pre-closure, improved post-closure. Distinguish these from the old10k-trained coefficients. Report inclusive means, CV, fractional-error RMS, quantile widths, tails, zeros and clipping; retain ten η/ten folded-φ bins and fourteen energy slices.
- **Uncertainty:** 200 full LC replicates are practical but yield coarse percentile tails. For fresh20k, distinguish 1,000 validation-only resamples from 200 training/closure/test refits. The latter remain conditional on selected hyperparameters unless tuning is repeated. Recompute fitted preprocessing/knots, or explicitly condition on the frozen basis. Resample within fixed sample roles and share validation multiplicities across comparators.
- **Fresh validation:** freeze the complete chain before inspection. Any subsequent tuning needs another independent validation sample.

Actual checks: all four assigned input hashes match previously reviewed source/results; governing instructions are unchanged. The existing staggered result retains mean **0.9191**, **8.54%** clipping and energy-slice means **0.886–0.939**, supporting explicit closure checks rather than assuming more statistics will remove bias.

No fits, simulation, writes or delegation. Later review should assess exact implementation and independent-validation results; this recommendation grants no acceptance or sign-off.
